title: plan_move input

snapshot_id.description: Default is the repository's current snapshot.

oneOf.description: A symbol by name and file, in place of its id.

name.description: The name a lean row shows (Driver.escape), or the plain name (escape); it must name one symbol in the file.

path.description: The repository-relative path of the file that declares the symbol.

subject_id.description: The top-level symbol to move to to_path: its id, or { name, path }. Give path, subject_id or key.

key.description: The symbol to move by its stable_key, in place of subject_id.

path.description: The repository-relative path of a file to move, in place of a symbol.

to_path.description: Where it goes: for a file, the repository-relative path it is to have, which no file has yet; for a symbol, the file it is to be declared in, new or existing.

envelope.description: compact leaves out the snapshot-wide parts of the envelope (unresolved reasons, standing limitations) that an earlier answer from the same snapshot already gave; query-specific limits stay. Over MCP, answers after the first full one per snapshot are compact unless full is asked for.

description: A read-only plan of every site a move of a file, or of a top-level symbol to another file, must change, with file and line: each statement that imports or re-exports it, with its specifier as written and as it must be; for a file, its own relative imports that its new place changes; for a symbol, the use in its old file that will need an import and what it uses that its new file must import, each observed; and strings and doc mentions that name the file's path, each inferred and to be reviewed. Changes no file.
